# Visual-motion fixture set

This directory is the checked-in #3 evidence set for `identity.visual-motion-manifest/v1`.

It contains a synthetic landing-sequence projection, digest-bound reduced-motion fallback, default motion policy, source/storyboard record, visual baseline, provenance manifest, and human-review note.

The files are deliberately tiny and deterministic. They prove contract behavior and review boundaries; they are not production creative assets. Relay-produced demo captures should conform to the same public contract rather than copying this fixture implementation.
